title: The round closed. Did the money arrive?
scope: Reader extract:15 central arrangements. This is not a global census or an additive funding total. Source keys below resolve to original documents. The research also examined other arrangements not tabulated in this extract.
rules: Null means unknown, not zero. Investor-reported funding is not an independent recipient bank audit.
Do not add round totals and their included components, borrowing, valuations, purchasing promises or guarantee caps.
Percentages, years and critical IT gigawatts are explicitly named; other numeric measures are USD billions.
Historical zero availability is not a current zero. Dates of announcements, payments, financial statements and inspection differ.

anthropic_facility.rule: Ceiling arithmetic only. First and last bars start at zero; deduction floats from20to15.

guarantee_gates.rule: Conditions diagram, not proportional cash flow. Redacted project-cost and pre-ready-for-service exceptions prevent an all-in loss estimate.

Covered-loss provisions depend on commencement, ready-for-service and qualifying default/notice/remedy terms. Redacted pre-RFS/project-cost exceptions prevent an all-in lifetime maximum or blanket no-earlier-cash assertion. Recovery rights are not assured recovery.
Payment required within3businessdays. Liquidation formula remains junior to creditors and specified securities; not guaranteed recovery. Later index resolves agreement date, not bank receipt.

limitations: Selected issuer disclosures and contract forms, not an audit of private books or an investment recommendation.
